Violent riots spread across France, prompting curfews and economic fallout

Violent riots erupted across France over the weekend, with protests turning into looting and arson; the French government responded by imposing curfews and officials pledged to restore order, while European governments issued security warnings to their citizens. Carrefour announced a cut to its financial guidance citing the unrest. Left‑leaning coverage described the riots as a political gift for Marine Le Pen and the far‑right, whereas right‑leaning coverage highlighted statements by Donald Trump and other right‑wing politicians blaming migrants and calling for closed borders.
